extDescription.message: 100% free ad blocker, no account needed. Blocks ads, trackers and YouTube ads.

globallyPaused.message: AdBlocker Free is paused on all sites.

unsupportedPage.message: AdBlocker Free doesn't run on the browser's internal pages.

pickerIntro.message: Hover over the ad and click it. Press Esc to cancel.

pickerConfirm.message: Is this what you want to hide? Move the slider to widen the selection.

pickerMatches.message: Will hide $COUNT$ element(s) on this page.

pickerNoMatch.message: The filter doesn't match any element.

enabledHint.message: Turn it off to pause AdBlocker Free on every site.

listEasylistDesc.message: Blocks the vast majority of ads on the web. Recommended.

listEasyprivacyDesc.message: Blocks trackers and analytics scripts that follow what you do online.

listYoutubeDesc.message: Removes YouTube video ads, banners and sponsored videos.

listAnnoyancesDesc.message: Hides cookie notices, newsletter pop-ups, social widgets and other distractions. May affect some sites.

listsFailed.message: Chrome refused to enable: $LISTS$. Another ad blocker may be using up the browser's rule limit.

allowlistHint.message: AdBlocker Free won't block anything on these sites or their subdomains.

customHint.message: One filter per line, using Adblock Plus / EasyList syntax. Anything you block with “Block an ad” shows up here.

aboutText.message: AdBlocker Free is free forever: no accounts, no subscriptions, no “acceptable ads” and no data sent to any server. Everything happens inside your browser.

aboutUpdate.message: To update the lists, run “npm run build:filters” in the project folder and reload the extension.
